cohort.note: 12 scored runs per leaderboard configuration, selected as the scorer selects them; gemini-3-5-flash has 11 because its scenario-D run 17258321 was deleted.

mapping.quality_gate: quality gate failed (score 0 or quality_check.pass false)
mapping.integrity: contamination / disallowed-model judgement or non-physical metrics
mapping.server_failure: no metrics.json or missing profiles (server unreachable / evaluation incomplete)

final_engine.note: text: first engine marker found in task/start_server.sh (sglang, tgi, lmdeploy, tensorrt, vllm; else custom); parsed: the trajectory parser's exec-line engine. ship_vllm_pct uses the text classification.

technique_mentions.note: share of cohort runs whose agent-authored transcript text (all sessions; prompt lines and user-role events excluded) matches the regex, case-insensitive

distinct_configs.note: metrics.n_distinct_configs from data/trajectories.json; bucket 3 = three or more
